title: Blood tax riots
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Blood tax riots", at revision 1361100963, opens: "The blood tax riots  were a series of violent uprisings around Japan in the spring of 1873 in opposition to the institution of mandatory military conscription for all male citizens in the wake of the Meiji Restoration. Secondary causes included popular anger at the Burakumin Emancipation Edict of 1871 and the institution of mandatory public schooling for children in 1872." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11625961, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "riots against military conscription in Japan, 1873". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
